AFTER pds-w47-measure-and-host-axis MERGES. It uses --measure; taking these figures by hand is the exact fraud this epic files.

THE DISCRIMINATOR THIS WAVE FOUND IS STRUCTURAL, 6/6, AND IT HAS A MECHANISM. Sort the six committed price literals by WHICH LEDGER HOLDS THEM and the separation is perfect: all FOUR PDS_DOOR_PRICES rows are THROUGH a required gate and ALL FOUR reproduce at matched load; the TWO PRICE-classed dispositions (legA=no legB=false, through NO door) are BOTH wrong. A THROUGH price is re-derived by reality on every merge — the door executes it, so the number is continuously contradictable. A PRICE-classed disposition is a price for an instrument NOTHING EVER RUNS: no gate can disagree with it, so it rots undisturbed. A PRICE DESCENDS FROM A MEASUREMENT ONLY IF SOMETHING RE-TAKES IT. That is the wish's sentence with a mechanism behind it, and it is why --measure is the fix.

THE TWO CONDEMNED ROWS, RE-TAKEN AT MATCHED LOAD (not at a quiet host — that is the point):
- pds-ledger-census_test.sh: stamped CPU=33.44+6.89=40.33s ... load1=24.26. Re-taken at load1 28.2-29.9 — HIGHER than its own stamp — three independent measurements give 18.7 / 20.06 / 22.11 / 22.30 / 22.38 / 24.45 s CPU. ~1.8x overstated; load cannot explain it.
- pds-scratch-target_test.sh: stamped CPU=4.83+4.08=8.91s ... load1=79.23. Re-taken 0.52-1.04 s across load1 32.8-70.0. 8.6-17x, and its USER CPU alone is 4.83 stamped vs 0.35-0.40 measured — user CPU is WORK; contention cannot produce 13x. The run is NOT degenerate: the full arm set executes, ---- 0 failure(s), SCRATCH TEST PASSED, rc=0, zero skips. That price does not describe this workload at any load.
The other four reproduce or are CONSERVATIVE and must not be touched: pds-status-only-residue.exs (0.82 stamped @26.44, re-takes 0.67-0.69), pds-record-parity.test.sh (4.45 @26.44, user 1.45 stamped vs 1.40-1.41 measured — 3%), pds-door-census.sh (1.07 @3.26, measured HIGHER at higher load), pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs (12.75 @2.93, measured HIGHER at higher load).

REFUTED AND NOT TO BE REBUILT — A load1 <= N CEILING. It is buildable and mutation-provable (proven: rc=1, ERRORS 4, THROUGH unmoved) and it is NOT a measurement-derived discriminator. The load ordering DOES NOT SORT honest from dishonest: pds-status-only-residue.exs is stamped at the "suspect" load1=26.44 and reproduces its user CPU to 0.01 s; pds-record-parity.test.sh at the same 26.44 to 3%; while the genuinely-broken pds-ledger-census_test.sh is stamped at a LOWER 24.26. A ceiling at 10 printed FOUR refusals of which TWO are false positives. Also refuted: pds-w46-load-stamp-provenance-doubt's comma-locale hypothesis — two independent instruments reproduce their user CPU to within 0.04 s AT load1 26.44, so the stamps are real load averages; all four entered main in ONE commit, ab8c86b05 (#9380). Two BUILD TRAPS recorded from that probe in case anything parses a stamp: row 223 carries TWO load1= tokens (its own 3.26 and an explicitly-disclaimed historical 41.63, so a last-token parse refuses the census's own honest price), and this host prints load averages with COMMA decimals.

ZERO HEADROOM WARNING: price_rows is EXACTLY 2 against assert length(price_rows) >= 2 at rider :324, and the :322 filter matches table rows whose DISPOSITION column is literally PRICE — i.e. exactly these two rows. RE-PRICING is safe. RE-CLASSING either row out of class PRICE drops it to 1 and REDS the required gate. If a re-take argues for a class change, the rider moves in the SAME COMMIT.

ROUND 1. Read PDS-D707 and PDS-D715 in the wave-49 charter section (PR #9637). The blocker is cleared: #9598 is on main, so `--measure` exists.

THIS ROW FOLDS pds-w48-retake-price-classed-rows (#9582), which describes the same two rows with weaker criteria. That row is closed as a duplicate; this one is the slice. That is D680's collision path walked, for the second time in this wave.

THE TWO CONDEMNED ROWS, still literal on origin/main at scripts/pds-door-census.sh:290-291, both stamped 2026-08-03 with the hand-typed `/usr/bin/time -p` meter and no `cpus=`:

  pds-scratch-target_test.sh  CPU=4.83+4.08=8.91s    load1=79.23  (rc=0, stub barkpark)

WAVE 49 ALREADY RE-TOOK BOTH BY --measure, 3 trials each. Re-take them yourself on your own host and quote YOUR OWN bands - do not paste these - but they tell you what to expect:
  ledger : 23.66 / 23.89 / 23.62 s @ load1 11.99 / 11.65 / 9.05  -> 1.14% spread, 1.70x under the condemned figure
  scratch: 0.53 / 0.52 / 0.55 s  @ load1 6.98 / 6.50 / 6.06     -> 5.8% spread, 16.8x under

FOUR CORRECTIONS TO THE ORIGINAL CRITERIA, all measured.

(1) CRITERION 3 IS RE-CUT. The digest's "the host is quieter now, load1 4.0-5.0" is REFUTED - every trial ran above it. The RULING (PDS-D715) is QUOTE AGAINST THE OBSERVED BAND, NOT REFUSE: the ledger figure moved 1.14% across a 32% load swing (9.05->11.99), which is itself a measurement that the figure is quotable against its own stamp under PDS-D656 ("ship the local CPU figure LABELLED LOCAL"). State load1 for every trial VERBATIM. A builder who writes "taken on a quiet host" is committing this epic's own disease. The two instruments' bands are NOT poolable - they were measured at systematically different loads.

(2) CRITERION 4's "0 failure(s)-class line" IS UNSATISFIABLE FOR ONE OF THE TWO. pds-scratch-target_test.sh prints `---- 0 failure(s)` then `SCRATCH TEST PASSED` (34 PASS arms). pds-ledger-census_test.sh prints `SELFTEST PASS: 173 checks.` and contains NO `failure(s)` string on the green path at all (its FAILURES counter only prints on the red path, :1400-1401). Quote each harness's ACTUAL tail and arm count. Note --measure DISCARDS the subject's stdout (`$cmd >/dev/null 2>&1`), so the tail needs a separate UN-METERED run alongside the three metered ones.

(3) THE WALL CLAUSE IS REFUSED, IN WRITING, AND THAT REFUSAL IS PART OF THIS SLICE. PDS-D692's mandate is scoped in its own text to "port-child riders" - a meter around a BEAM. Measured this wave: `bash -c 'bash -c "<busy loop>" >/dev/null 2>&1; times'` prints `0m0.001s 0m0.001s` for the shell and `0m0.871s 0m0.072s` for ITS CHILDREN, and measure_sum (:1450-1454) awk-accumulates over BOTH records. `times` is NOT blind to OS children, and both condemned instruments are plain bash harnesses whose entire cost is direct-descendant CPU. Paying the wall clause here would require editing run_measure AND relaxing the required rider's refute at pds_door_census_test.exs:384 - and would buy nothing. WRITE THE REFUSAL WITH THE MEASUREMENT; do not edit the rider.
CARRY: row :290 currently reads `(rc=0, wall 68.24 s)` and survives `\bwall\b.*=` only because no `=` follows the word. The --measure re-take DROPS that wall figure entirely (the old meter was /usr/bin/time -p; --measure is not). Reproduce the no-`=` prose shape or the required rider reds.

(4) THE ANCHOR IN THE OLD BRIEF WAS OFF BY TWO: the `assert length(price_rows) >= 2` is at pds_door_census_test.exs:344, and the wall refute is at :384 (not :386).

TWO BLOCKERS THE ORIGINAL DISPATCH DID NOT NAME. `grep -c PRICE` returns 3, not 2 - it also catches the COUNTS line `PRICE : 2 of 20`; counted with the rider's own regex the answer is 2, so there is ZERO downward headroom. And CRITERION 1's rider leg CANNOT RUN in a fresh worktree: api/deps and api/_build do not exist there and `mix test` dies on ~40 Hex packages. Budget a full `mix deps.get` + compile; per the known-broken build-borrow you may NOT borrow api/_build from the main checkout.

ONE MORE THING TO CARRY, NOT NECESSARILY TO FIX: the scratch-target row's stated REASON ("Hermeticity on a runner WITHOUT local Postgres is unproven here") is already REFUTED BY RUN per the open row pds-w45-bl-scratch-target-class-refuted. Re-taking the FIGURE while leaving the REASON standing ships a repaired number under an unrepaired justification. Move both fields together, or say in writing why you did not.
